# JetBrains Marketplace Store Description — Robot Framework Professional

```html
<h2>Robot Framework Professional — Full IDE Intelligence for Robot Framework</h2>

<p>
  Turn your JetBrains IDE into a complete Robot Framework development environment.
  Intelligent code completion, step-through debugging, interactive REPL, and built-in
  web inspector — everything you need to write, run, and debug Robot Framework tests.
</p>

<h3>Editing and Navigation</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Syntax Highlighting</b> — Full support for Robot Framework 7+ keywords, variables, and sections</li>
  <li><b>Code Completion</b> — Context-aware suggestions for keywords, variables, and library imports</li>
  <li><b>Go-To Declaration</b> — Jump to keyword definitions and find references across files</li>
  <li><b>Rename Refactoring</b> — Safely rename keywords across all project files</li>
  <li><b>Structure View</b> — Browse test cases, keywords, and variables in a tree view</li>
  <li><b>Code Folding</b> — Collapse sections, test cases, and keywords</li>
</ul>

<h3>Code Quality</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Inspections</b> — Detect long test names, empty test cases, undefined keywords, and missing resources</li>
  <li><b>Error Annotations</b> — Syntax errors, undefined variables, and duplicate keywords highlighted inline</li>
  <li><b>Spellchecking</b> — Spell check support for Robot Framework files</li>
  <li><b>Parameter Hints</b> — Inline parameter hints for keyword arguments</li>
</ul>

<h3>Execution and Debugging</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Test Execution</b> — Run tests directly from the editor with rich output</li>
  <li><b>Step-Through Debugger</b> — Breakpoints, variable inspection, and conditional breakpoints (Pro)</li>
  <li><b>Interactive REPL</b> — Test keywords in real time without running full suites (Pro)</li>
  <li><b>Performance Profiler</b> — Find slow keywords and optimize execution time (Pro)</li>
</ul>

<h3>Web Testing</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Web Inspector</b> — Built-in browser element inspector for locator generation (Pro)</li>
  <li><b>SeleniumLibrary Support</b> — Full completion and navigation for SeleniumLibrary keywords</li>
</ul>

<h3>Pricing</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Free</b> — Syntax highlighting, code completion, navigation, inspections, basic test execution</li>
  <li><b>Pro</b> — Advanced debugger, performance profiler, web inspector, interactive REPL, parallel execution</li>
</ul>

<h3>Requirements</h3>
<ul>
  <li>IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, or compatible JetBrains IDE (2024.1+)</li>
  <li>Python with Robot Framework installed</li>
</ul>

<h3>Support</h3>
<ul>
  <li>Documentation: <a href="https://jakubjirak.com">jakubjirak.com</a></li>
  <li>Issues: <a href="https://github.com/jakubjirak">GitHub</a></li>
  <li>Email: support@jakubjirak.com</li>
</ul>
```
